name: Darkroom Development
summary: In a red safelight room the metrics print slowly develops in the tray, but the coral mark on the problem is there first, because Acme Pulse already found it.
look: A deep red safelight world of trays, drying lines and wooden pins, quiet and tactile. Prints climb from grey to full contrast through rippling liquid; the drop is a hard lights-on cut to white paper, teal and coral.

components.name: Safelight vignette
components.role: radial red glow on near-black; the before-world where nothing is readable

components.name: Developer tray
components.role: top-down tray with concentric ripple rings (feDisplacementMap in motion)

components.name: Latent print
components.role: any UI or chart whose contrast climbs from 0.1 to 1

components.name: Pre-developed mark
components.role: coral ring and number at full density from frame one; the agent's finding

components.name: Timer dial
components.role: pie-wedge darkroom timer; time passing without a progress bar

components.name: Drying line
components.role: wire, wooden pins and hanging prints; dashboards before, results after

motion.name: Chemical emergence
motion.how: filter contrast/brightness 0.1→1, sine.inOut over 4 s (2 bars at 120 BPM); the coral mark is already there

motion.name: Liquid rock
motion.how: displacement scale 6→0 on a slow 1 s sine as the tray settles; ripple rings expand on each kick

motion.name: Lights-on cut
motion.how: hard cut red → white on the 0:08 drop with a 2-frame overexposure flash

story: Hook: under safelight, underexposed dashboard prints sway on a drying line: 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.' Reveal: hard lights-on cut; a finished print swings in on its pin showing the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse', teal drips falling. Proof: back in the red room a checkout-conversion print develops in the tray, but the coral ring and '−18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231' are already dense; the Roll back tag lights up as the timer passes 0:42. CTA: in daylight three dry prints hang (Signups ✓, the mark, 'Resolved in 6 min') above 'Caught before customers noticed.' and Start free.
adapt: Put your own report, chart or screen on the print, pre-develop the one thing your product catches, and use the lights-on cut as your product reveal.

fit.risk: The all-red palette hides brand colour until the lights-on payoff, so that cut has to land hard.
